hypotheses.mechanism: The admitted G9 V3 source and admitted EBNF are not self-conformant because G9 uses relational operators and an if-form absent from grammar.ebnf.
hypotheses.expected: A grammar-conformant parser rejects at least the >, >= and if examples taken from G9 V3.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Those forms are intentionally outside the grammar and another canonical parser surface owns them.
hypotheses.falsifier: A current canonical parser/grammar accepted by the stack parses G9 V3 unchanged and produces the canonical IR.
hypotheses.result: Current grammar cannot admit the sampled constructs; minimal repair candidate parses/lowers the tested subset.
hypotheses.stage_implication: CC-WP-01/02 need a self-conformance fixture before parser freeze.

hypotheses.mechanism: Treating relational/control completion as surface grammar only can preserve canonical semantic identity for equivalent programs.
hypotheses.expected: Pre/post repair programs that encode the same tested predicate produce identical canonical semantic hashes after canonicalization.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Adding control syntax changes evaluation order or effect semantics and therefore semantic identity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Roundtrip/canonicalization yields divergent IR or observable behavior for equivalent intended programs.
hypotheses.next_test: Implement the real parser/canonicalizer and semantic-hash oracle; compare repaired surface forms against explicit predicate/branch IR.

hypotheses.mechanism: Progressive lowering with explicit legality targets and translation validation will expose semantic escape hatches earlier than direct source-to-host transpilation.
hypotheses.expected: Each lowering stage can reject illegal residual Clay operations and emit a semantic-preservation receipt.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A direct compiler is simpler and equally testable for BASE.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched implementation shows staged lowering adds repair/latency complexity without finding additional semantic failures.
hypotheses.external_basis: MLIR DialectConversion uses explicit conversion targets, rewrite patterns and optional type conversion; full conversion succeeds only when all illegal operations are legalized.
hypotheses.next_test: Build Clay AST -> typed Clay IR -> host/WASI IR with a full-conversion legality check.

hypotheses.mechanism: WASI 0.3 Component Model can cover a large fraction of ClayCode BASE host-boundary needs through typed WIT resources, capability-scoped imports and native async primitives.
hypotheses.expected: APP-01 CLI, APP-02 HTTP, APP-03 DB adapter, APP-04 async service and APP-08 sandboxed effect can be lowered without ambient authority or bespoke untyped wire formats.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Direct Ubuntu native/LLVM FFI is materially simpler/faster and can preserve the same authority contract.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target-host benchmark shows WASI requires larger escape hatches, lacks required APIs or imposes unacceptable implementation/runtime cost.
hypotheses.next_test: Native-vs-WASI matched exemplar on Andreas Ubuntu host.

hypotheses.mechanism: Current G9 typed Delta/provenance/effect/state/graph structures are sufficient to encode the currently loaded ClayGraph and UnifiedDB identity/epoch/receipt semantics; missing work is compiler/runtime realization rather than a new semantic primitive.
hypotheses.expected: Representative graph epoch, hyperrelation, selection receipt, semantic transaction, query receipt and dynamic work revision structures lower without an untyped semantic escape hatch.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: At least one current substrate invariant requires a new ClayCode primitive rather than a record/interface composition.
hypotheses.falsifier: Executable substrate exemplar cannot be typed or replayed without erasing provenance, epoch identity, authority or rollback semantics.
hypotheses.next_test: Compile one ClayGraph projection/selection receipt and one UnifiedDB semantic transaction/replay exemplar using frozen G9 records.

hypotheses.mechanism: The current research grammar is not yet a complete general-purpose executable surface even after the minimal repair; BASE therefore needs either a small explicit computational control core or a verified lowering from another existing ClayCode program representation.
hypotheses.expected: General-purpose APP suite exposes missing function/result/iteration/error/concurrency constructs unless they already exist in another current executable dialect/runtime artifact.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Existing universal-core/direct dialect artifacts already supply all computational control and grammar.ebnf is only the architecture-spec surface.
hypotheses.falsifier: Current repository contains and target-executes a canonical parser/runtime path covering APP-01..10 without adding control semantics to the admitted language basis.
hypotheses.next_test: Inventory the 20k universal-core proxy artifact and bind it to the current G9 parser/IR identity; do not reinvent what already exists.

strongest_current_delta: H-CC-BASE-001: self-conformance gap is directly evidenced; repair remains candidate-only until integrated into the real parser/canonical IR pipeline.
